ops.title: Ship cc_transcript.mining.sampling (sample_windows, turn_anchor, fold_trigger) for cc-steer's watcher
ops.description:
cc-steer commit `cd272da feat(watcher): live steering cascade` was written against a `cc_transcript.mining.sampling` module that has never existed at any cc-transcript version or branch (verified: `git log --all -S "sample_windows" -- cc_transcript` is empty; `cc_transcript/mining/` has no `sampling.py`).

Consumers in cc-steer (all broken at import today):
- `cc_steer/negatives.py:29` — `from cc_transcript.mining import sample_windows` (used at :150)
- `cc_steer/watcher/daemon.py` — same family
- `tests/test_daemon.py` — `from cc_transcript.mining.sampling import fold_trigger, turn_anchor`

This blocks collection of 5 cc-steer test modules (test_negatives, test_pipeline, test_shadow, test_cli_sync, test_daemon — the latter four chain through cli → pipeline → negatives). The cc-transcript 11.0.0 bump in cc-steer (099ce04) is independent of this: the errors fail identically at 9.x/10.x/11.0.

Likely owned by the platform-2.0 effort (a `platform-2.0` bookmark exists in cc-transcript; a parallel session advanced cc-steer's pin to 10.2.0 with an editable `../cc-transcript` source). Whoever claims this should reverse-engineer the intended API from the three cc-steer call sites rather than inventing one, and coordinate with that session's plans before landing.

ops.text: cc_transcript.mining.sampling exists with sample_windows, turn_anchor, fold_trigger matching cc-steer's call sites
cc-steer's 5 blocked test modules collect and pass against the shipped module
